images.alt: The FSP Hydro G 850W Power Supply has a lot going for it. For the reasonable price of $140US you're getting a unit that's Gold certified, has Japanese capacitors, comes with a 5 year warranty, is completely modular, looks sharp and is virtually silent.
FSP‬ Hydro G 850W is a relatively quiet power supply during normal operation. It provided good quality voltage regulation. Its ripple control and standby efficiency are also rated as top notch.

FSP Hydro G 850 proved to be a solid unit that delivered very good performance with minimal noise and an attractive price. The cooling fan is very quiet and the power supply operates in silent fan-less mode at low power levels.
